question: Should OpenClaw require automatic migration for these released skills, or intentionally accept manual recovery as a breaking upgrade?
rationale: The branch changes a shipped support contract and official package-ownership policy; code review cannot decide whether that user-visible break is acceptable.

options.title: Require automatic migration
options.body: Keep each released skill bundled until Doctor can migrate it to a verified owner-qualified replacement without ambiguity.

options.title: Accept manual breaking upgrade
options.body: Ship the removals with explicit release communication and ongoing support responsibility for manual recovery.

options.title: Narrow the removal set
options.body: Remove only skills with unambiguous proven migration paths and defer the remainder.

recommendation.title: Require automatic migration
recommendation.body: Keep each released skill bundled until Doctor can migrate it to a verified owner-qualified replacement without ambiguity.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned and has led the active migration, with Peter Steinberger owning adjacent release and provenance contracts.
